name: singularity-preview-verification
description: Verify the approved illustrated Showdown Singularity replay against generated slot layouts and a real browser. Join independent results in a fresh reviewer context.

steps.prompt: Run shell commands as separate tool calls. Write only generated assets or outputs under the ignored dist/ and .artifacts/ paths. Report exact exit codes and evidence. If a required command fails, signal error and report that failure. Run git rev-parse HEAD, then git diff --exit-code 172890d0cd812b6665804e0b92313f7c698c33fe -- src assets, then node scripts/build-graybox.mjs --diorama. Report the commit, whether protected source and assets are identical to the approved revision, and the build result. If all passed signal success.

branches.prompt: Run shell commands as separate tool calls. Write only generated assets or outputs under the ignored dist/ and .artifacts/ paths. Report exact exit codes and evidence. If a required command fails, signal error and report that failure. Run exactly: node --test tests/match/showdown-3d-presentation.test.js. Record the test counts, the generated Singularity layouts and the dropped-hit control; report any limitations. If it passed, signal success.

Run shell commands as separate tool calls. Write only generated assets or outputs under the ignored dist/ and .artifacts/ paths. Report exact exit codes and evidence. If a required command fails, signal error and report that failure. Use the existing HTML from the build step. Run exactly: node scripts/browser-showdown-singularity.mjs dist/cowboys-vs-wizards-showdown-3d.html .artifacts/kiro/singularity/native. Read the machine-readable result and report its HTML SHA-256, both outcomes, and which motion modes were checked. If the browser checks pass, signal success.
